Fed officials wait for CPI before rate-cut decision

Federal Reserve officials said inflation data will guide whether the FOMC cuts interest rates later this year.

Jerome Powell told reporters that policymakers need several more readings before they can say price pressure is easing.

Investors focused on the next CPI report, Treasury yields, and whether rate-cut expectations would move after the meeting.

Economists said prediction markets were likely to react if the report changed the path for monetary policy.
